name: Haiku deep value
strategy: Deep value focus on companies trading well below intrinsic value on P/E, price-to-book, and FCF metrics. Targets operationally sound businesses with strong dividends and cash generation positioned for valuation mean reversion and multiple expansion in H1 2026.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: Portfolio concentrates on deeply discounted value stocks across financials, energy, and industrials offering substantial upside from multiple expansion. These established, cash-generative businesses trade at historic lows on fundamentals; recovery in investor sentiment and interest rate normalization should drive H1 2026 outperformance relative to the broad market.
